mapper.update: UPDATE log_alarm SET task_id = #{taskId}, level = #{level}, root_cause = #{rootCause}, solution = #{solution}, log_content = #{logContent}, push_status = #{pushStatus}, lifecycle_status = #{lifecycleStatus}, ack_by = #{ackBy}, ack_time = #{ackTime}, handled_by = #{handledBy}, handled_time = #{handledTime}, closed_time = #{closedTime}, escalation_level = #{escalationLevel}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE alarm_id = #{alarmId}

UPDATE log_alarm SET lifecycle_status = #{lifecycleStatus}, ack_by = CASE WHEN #{lifecycleStatus}='ACKNOWLEDGED' THEN #{operator} ELSE ack_by END, ack_time = CASE WHEN #{lifecycleStatus}='ACKNOWLEDGED' THEN NOW() ELSE ack_time END, handled_by = CASE WHEN #{lifecycleStatus}='HANDLED' THEN #{operator} ELSE handled_by END, handled_time = CASE WHEN #{lifecycleStatus}='HANDLED' THEN NOW() ELSE handled_time END, closed_time = CASE WHEN #{lifecycleStatus}='CLOSED' THEN NOW() ELSE closed_time END, update_time = NOW() WHERE alarm_id = #{alarmId}
UPDATE log_alarm SET escalation_level = escalation_level + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE alarm_id = #{alarmId}
